dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Now that was a great warm-up! Most praiseworthy.

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: But I still have a problem with the muscle groups that are used for rock climbing.

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: Don't give up just yet! Let me finish.

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: You can't only use your arms just because your legs are a bit uncoordinated. How can you put extra pressure on something that was already lacking in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: We're going to focus on training your arms next. Understood?

dialogues.speaker: Humboldt
dialogues.text: ...Wait, didn't I come here to sightsee? How did I get roped into a fitness class?

dialogues.speaker: Roca
dialogues.text: All the tourist attractions in Natlan are kind of like this. You'll get used to it.

dialogues.speaker: Humboldt
dialogues.text: I see... Guess I'll take your word for it?
